program_solutions:
(rule!
  (for/fold ([out g]) ([color (in-list (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v 0))) (grid-colors g)))])
    (let ((pts (find-color g color)))
      (if (= (length pts) 3)
          (let* ((rs (sort (remove-duplicates (map first pts)) <))
                 (cs (sort (remove-duplicates (map second pts)) <)))
            (if (and (= (length rs) 2) (= (length cs) 2))
                (let* ((corners (for*/list ([r (in-list rs)] [c (in-list cs)]) (list r c)))
                       (missing (filter (lambda (p) (not (member? p pts))) corners)))
                  (if (= (length missing) 1)
                      (set-cell out (first (first missing)) (second (first missing)) color)
                      out))
                out))
          out))))
